Frequently asked questions
How do I sign up? Click Sign up or Login, enter your work email, and sign in through Starﬂeet.
Personal emails are not allowed.
Why do I see “Access denied”? Your identity was veriﬁed but your account is not authorized
under current policies. Contact computematchmake@nvidia.com or sign in with another work
account.
Why do I see “Your access is being reviewed”? Your company is an NVIDIA partner but its NCP
organization is not on the platform yet. A Platform Admin must approve your access request.
How many NCPs can I send one request to? Up to 3 in the UI by default (backend allows up to
10), if you have the multi-NCP permission.
Will I get several contracts if I send to several NCPs? No. The options are alternatives; the ﬁrst
NCP to conﬁrm the contract wins and the others are cancelled.
How long does an NCP have to respond? 7 days to accept, then 45 days to contract. Reminders
arrive 3 days before each deadline. Admins can extend both.
My magic link says it expired. Links last 1 hour. Ask for a resend (possible for 7 days after routing)
or log in normally and open Manage reservation.
Can I accept an NCP counteroffer as a customer? The customer detail page is view and cancel
only; the NCP conﬁrms the contract after you agree with them directly.
When can I cancel? While the request is Awaiting NCP Acceptance, awaiting approval, In Process
or Expired; custom requests while Open or In Review.
What if no cluster matches my needs? Submit a custom request. Admins will review and mark it
Matched or Unserviceable.
My CSV upload shows Pending Review. It contains future capacity (starting more than 90 days
out); a Platform Admin must accept it.
My CSV upload shows Validation Failed. Open “See all details” for row errors. Check the ﬁve
required columns, UTF-8 encoding, 10 MB and 10,000-row limits.
Why can’t I see Upload Capacities or Manage reservation? You lack the scope
( manage_inventory  or approver_manage_reservation_request ). Basic NCP users are read-only. Ask your
Platform Admin.
I have customer and NCP access. How do I switch? Use Switch proﬁle to at the top of the
account menu.
Where is the user manual? Click the book icon in the header; it opens the manual ﬁltered to your
role. The ?  icon shows help for the current page.
What does What’s New show? Release highlights for your persona. A banner appears on your
landing page for about 7 days; dismissing it keeps it under the bell icon. Use Mark All as Read to
clear the unread dot.
How do I give feedback? Use Share Feedback in the header, or answer the star rating after
creating a request or uploading capacity.
What’s New — October 2026 release (v1.3.0)
Customers: faster, more compact request submission; real-time tracking of custom requests
from Open to In Review to Matched.
NCPs: clearer upload status and errors; sign in directly through the NPN portal.
Admins: complete custom request workﬂow (Open →  In Review →  Matched or Unserviceable)
in the admin view.
